change.item: ⁠Accordions now open one panel at a time: opening a question closes the previous one.
⁠The mega menu no longer overflows the page: its columns tighten instead.

fix.item: ⁠A hidden article title stays the main heading of the page, invisible but read by screen readers.
⁠A page made only of bands now has its main area, and “Skip to main content” leads there.
⁠Definition lists that carry a class are no longer distorted.

note.item: ⁠Requires Joomla 6.2 or newer. Nothing to set again.

addition.item: ⁠“Brand colour” setting: Corpus keeps your hue and adjusts its lightness itself, so it stays readable in light and in dark.
⁠“Secondary colour” setting, for rules and dividers.
⁠“Submenu alignment” setting: start, centre or end.
⁠Fonts: headings at weight 500, a bold italic file, variable fonts, and a second self-hosted font for headings.

fix.item: ⁠Page outline: the links now reach the headings when the article has an introduction.
⁠An outline column that also carries a module no longer overlaps anything: the whole column stays fixed on screen.
⁠A module title set as h1 now takes the size of an h1.

change.item: ⁠The small texts in the top row of the header are now styled (size, colour, links).
⁠Submenus no longer follow the alignment of the menu bar.

note.item: ⁠Requires Joomla 6.2 or newer. A site still on Joomla 6.1 keeps its current version and is offered nothing that could break it.
⁠Nothing to set again: the new settings are empty by default.

addition.item: ⁠Twelve new icons for the file tools: upload, download, new folder, rename, move, copy, crop, compress, delete, gallery, insert, replace.

fix.item: ⁠Joomla 6.2: the intro image of an article came out without its figure when it had no caption. Blogs lost their layout (image left or right, lead article on two columns).
⁠Corpus always puts the image back inside its figure, in 6.1 as in 6.2. Needed before moving a site to Joomla 6.2.
